utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. I’m still lining up a few helpers for setup and sorting on Saturday at the front porch, so any practical help would really keep things from getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — I can help with setup and sorting on Saturday, and I’ll bring a couple of labels and bins too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch - I can help out. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you! If you can come a little early, I’d love help setting up tables and checking in any items folks bring by.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik. Can you help set up tables and greet people when they arrive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can do tables and greet people when they arrive. I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Tess. I’ll be there Saturday on the front porch to greet folks and sort the tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — that’s a huge help. I’ll see you Saturday on the front porch!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help on Saturday at the front porch. Just tell me what you need me to do.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Uli. I’ll probably need you to help set up and then hand tools to folks when they show up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Vik. Can you help me set up the front porch area on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep, I can help set up the front porch on Saturday. I’ll be there for the repair drive and can help with setup and sorting.
